units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 4:2">Deut. R. s. 4</cite> [read:] <he>הרי מ׳ והרי כבלים אם עשית רצוני הרי מ׳ של זהב ואם לאו וכ׳</he> (v.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 256">Yalk. Is. 256</cite>) here is a necklace and here are chains; if thou doest my will, here is a golden necklace for thee; if not &c.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 29:1">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <he>ענקים</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 1:9">Prov. I, 9</cite>) <he>עשה הקב״ה … כמ׳ וכ׳</he> (not … <he>קית</he>) the Lord made the letters of the Torah like necklaces and suspended them &c.
